name: venu-profile
description: Portfolio site for Venu Akkamgari - Next.js frontend, Fastify + MongoDB backend.

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:up: docker start venu-profile-mongo || docker run -d --name venu-profile-mongo -p 27018:27017 -v venu-profile-mongo-data:/data/db --restart unless-stopped mongo:7
